text:
raj: Heads-up — while testing the new openmodel-v2 weights I noticed our chat template ends up with two leading BOS-ish tokens: `<s> <s>` before the system role. That makes the role parser think there's an empty user turn. weights are at s3://redwood-models/openmodel-v2/, can someone sanity-check?

maria: oof, good catch. do you have the tokenizer config you used?

raj: quick paste of what came out of the hf-resolved files: ```json
{"bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>", "unk_token": "<unk>", "sep_token": "</s>", "add_prefix_space": false}
```
I didn't override anything on our side, just used AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(path).

kyle: sounds like the model's vocab includes a BOS token and the chat template also explicitly prepends one. We have two levers: stop adding the template BOS, or unset tokenizer.bos_token on load. Which is safer for downstream callers?

sophie: for Hosted API I'd prefer changing the prompt wrapper to not inject another `<s>` if tokenizer already has bos_token set. That avoids changing model artifacts. Also add a validation step in onboarding: check tokenizer.bos_token vs template.

noah: agree with sophie. I'll open a tiny PR to `platform/prompt-wrappers` to check `if tokenizer.bos_token is not None: skip_template_bos=True`. Minimal and reversible.

raj: @noah thanks — can you also add a note to the model-card that the tokenizer has a native bos? People expect chat templates to behave consistently.

infra-bot: Config validator found a mismatch for openmodel-v2: tokenizer.bos_token present AND template_bos=true -> WARN (ticket #INF-4831).

maria: regression test idea: feed "system: hi" template and ensure output tokens don't include an extra empty message token. Put this in `tests/onboarding/tokenizer_regressions.py`.

noah: noted. I'll include a small unit that tokenizes the wrapped prompt and asserts there is only one leading `<s>` and that role separators are at expected indices.

kyle: small gotcha: some HF tokenizers treat `<s>` as part of normal vocab and collapse consecutive tokens on decode. Add a decode check in the test to catch subtle differences.

raj: ok plan: no model artifact changes, change wrapper behavior, add onboarding validator, regression test, update model-card. @sophie can you add the checklist item?

sophie: added to onboarding checklist doc and assigned to noah for the PR. :white_check_mark:

raj: perfect — thanks team. tagging this thread resolved unless infra-bot surfaces more warnings.

infra-bot: Auto-close in 72h if no new warnings.
